_schema_meta.description: JSON schema definition for rules.ng.v1.0.json — the WellaPath Nigeria red flag rules artifact. Every rule object must conform to this schema exactly. Red flag rules evaluate BEFORE scoring and ALWAYS override urgency when matched.
locked_principles: Red flag override always takes priority — this is non-negotiable
Rules evaluate before scoring — not after
Global rules (applies_to: all) fire for every condition evaluation
Condition-specific rules only fire when that condition is in top candidates
All tokens must exist in red_flag_tokens in token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json
override_urgency must always be 'emergency' for global rules

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier. Format: rf_NNN (zero-padded to 3 digits). Global rules: rf_001–rf_099. Condition-specific rules: rf_100+.
constraints: Must be unique across entire rules file

rule_name.description: Human-readable rule name for audit and display purposes.

token.description: Red flag token this rule evaluates. Must exist in red_flag_tokens in token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json.

override_urgency.description: Urgency level to force when this rule fires. Global rules must always be 'emergency'. Condition-specific rules may be 'urgent' if not immediately life-threatening.

applies_to.description: Scope of this rule. Use ["all"] for global rules that apply to every condition evaluation. Use a list of specific condition_ids for condition-scoped rules.
applies_to.valid_values: ['all'] OR array of condition_id strings matching condition_id fields in kb.ng.v1.0.json

explanation.description: Clinical explanation of why this is a danger sign. Used for audit, medical review, and future UI display. Not shown to patients directly.
explanation.example: Inability to drink or feed is a universal danger sign requiring immediate emergency care.

priority.description: Evaluation priority. 1 = highest, evaluated first. Global rules should have priority 1–10. Condition-specific rules 11+. Within same priority level, rules evaluate in array order.

_override_urgency_enum.emergency: Immediate life-threatening danger — always use for global rules
_override_urgency_enum.urgent: Needs same-day professional care — only valid for condition-specific rules

_applies_to_rules.global: applies_to: ["all"] — evaluates for every condition assessment regardless of top candidates
_applies_to_rules.condition_specific: applies_to: ["condition_id_1", "condition_id_2"] — only evaluates when that condition is in the scoring top candidates

_evaluation_order: 1. Evaluate ALL global red flag rules (applies_to: all) first — highest priority
2. If any global rule fires → set urgency to emergency, stop evaluation, return result
3. Evaluate condition-specific rules for conditions in top 3 scoring candidates
4. If condition-specific rule fires → escalate urgency for that condition
5. Only after all red flag evaluation completes → run weighted scoring
6. Red flag result always overrides scoring output — never the reverse

_annotated_example_global.explanation: Inability to drink or feed is a universal danger sign in both adults and children. It indicates severe dehydration, altered consciousness, or systemic collapse — any of which require immediate emergency care.

_annotated_example_condition_specific.explanation: Severe chest indrawing in a child indicates severe pneumonia by IMCI classification. Requires emergency referral — do not manage at community level.
